what_was_done: Removed the extra approved_by_operator requirement from submit_paper_order for paper mode while keeping SUPEREZIO_ENABLE_PAPER_ORDER_SUBMIT, ticket_allowed, LMT, and limit_price gates.
Enabled SUPEREZIO_ENABLE_PAPER_ORDER_SUBMIT=1 in runtime/do_restart.ps1 so the local stack boots in gated IBKR paper-submit mode.

Restored submit_paper_order to discovery/ticker cognitive contracts and updated Bob's mission context to say paper submission is allowed through the gated tool, while live-money execution remains prohibited.
Fixed the deterministic Bob renderer so paper mode says PAPER_ORDER_SUBMIT_READY/PAPER_ORDER_SUBMITTED/PAPER_ORDER_SUBMIT_FAILED instead of always saying pending human approval.
Added explicit no-order protection: if the user says not to send an order, Bob must not call submit_paper_order even when the paper gate is enabled.
Fixed decimal share sizing so CAD/USD 10,000 at price 3.20 calculates 3125 shares instead of 3124 from float precision.
Fixed paper-order routing bugs where IBKR paper prompts were misclassified as broker-status or ticker_analysis for ticker IBKR instead of market_scan.
Fixed submit_paper_order duplicate handling so a stale executed_tools entry without broker result/error does not block the first real broker attempt.
Added direct post-tool synthesis so Bob finalizes immediately from submit_paper_order_result or submit_paper_order_error instead of looping through the local model again.
Updated DEBUT_PROTOCOL to distinguish gated paper order submission from prohibited live-money execution.
Fixed two unrelated full-suite regressions found during validation: unsupported exact debt-return phrasing and stale pipeline node-count expectation.
